mapper.select: SELECT status AS state, count(*) AS total FROM sessions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL AND status IN ('running', 'rescheduling') GROUP BY status
SELECT count(*) AS total FROM sessions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL AND status = 'running' AND updated_at < #{staleBefore}

SELECT COALESCE(worker_status, 'unknown') AS worker_status, connection_status AS connection_status, count(*) AS total FROM code_sessions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'active' GROUP BY COALESCE(worker_status, 'unknown'), connection_status
SELECT state AS state, count(*) AS total FROM environment_work WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND state IN ('queued', 'starting', 'active', 'stopping') GROUP BY state

SELECT COALESCE(CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MIN(COALESCE(queued_at, created_at)))) AS bigint), 0) AS age_seconds FROM environment_work WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND state = 'queued' AND COALESCE(queued_at, created_at) <= NOW()
SELECT count(*) AS total FROM environment_work WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND state = 'starting' AND updated_at < #{startedBefore}
SELECT state AS state, count(*) AS total FROM environment_sandboxes WHERE state IN ('creating', 'running', 'stopping') GROUP BY state
